text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The "Junior Cup"... If she can prove her 
strength here, the Classic races will be 
well within sight.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The Classic races I longed for... A 
Classic season where McQueen might not be 
there...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm having wicked thoughts! Like wondering 
if it might actually be safer without 
McQueen around!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
With such a weak mindset, I won't be able 
to run well today, let alone in the 
Classics.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's right. I swore an oath. That I 
would become stronger.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I'll show them how dependable I can be. 
To Trainer, and to Grandmother, who still 
believes in me."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"If I'm truly a strong horse girl, it 
doesn't matter who runs or who doesn't! 
That's why!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'll show everyone in this race that 
Mejiro Ryan is a true Classic contender!!
